title: A modular obstruction to the $P$-adic Leopoldt conjecture for the Carlitz module
summary: Let $L$ be a finite extension of $K=\mathbb{F}_q(\theta)$ and $P$ a monic prime of $\mathbb{F}_q[\theta]$. Anglès asked whether the $P$-adic Leopoldt defect of Taelman's module of units of the Carlitz module over $L$ always vanishes, and Lucas conjectured this, together with the equivalence "$L_P(E/\mathcal{O}_L)\neq 0$ iff $\exp_E$ is injective", for Anderson modules. We show that both statements fail.
